stages.legendary: Paint the same armory one step further, between the grand and the mythic. Everything from grand stays. It becomes a tall stone hall with a huge front opening, only five suits of armour in all, in one single row along the back wall, each clearly empty on a wooden stand with its pole visible through the neck, no helmet crests, with one suit of matte dark steel scale on a central stand, walls of great shields and tall weapons in rows, a rolling ladder. The back corner starts rising into a square stone tower with a flat top. No glow on armour or weapons. A hint of old magic: two iron cressets at the door burn with small pale blue cold flames. Nobody in the image, no people at all. Footprint unchanged, exactly 2 by 2 tiles, growth goes up and stays inside the canvas. stages.mythic: Edit the concept and go much further. Keep the great stone hall with its huge front open like a cutaway, its walls of tall weapons and shields. Walls whole and sound, never ruined. Remove every person completely. Reduce the armour to twelve large suits of engraved dark steel and matte bronze in three clean rows, each clearly empty on a wooden stand with its pole visible through the neck, helmets with closed visors, so it reads as objects and never as a crowd. A rolling ladder, a polishing stool and a folded rag stay in the middle, and the worn pull-up beam and heavy shield stay at the opening. The building itself is far grander than the stage before: the hall has a second storey of fine dressed stone with tall arched windows lit warm, and a stone wing with its own gable rises on each side of the tower, so it is a palace of an armory with several roofs and floors. The towering element: from the back corner a square stone tower rises to three times the height of the hall, crowned by a colossal plain great helm of matte dark steel, wider than the tower, serving as its roof, no plume, closed, no light inside it. Strong magic layer, clear by day and by night: at the four corners of the tower and along the top of the walls, tall iron cressets burn with very tall pale blue cold flames, sending long curling trails of pale blue light in a slow spiral around the tower under the helm. No glow on armour or weapons, no shine. Warm lit windows in the tower. Nobody in the image, no people at all. Footprint unchanged, exactly 2 by 2 tiles, growth goes up and stays inside the canvas. No letters or runes, no hanging cloth, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow, no fog patches, no sheet of grey smoke. Matte, no gloss, no gilding. Feathered natural ground patch, same iso angle, same ink outlines, warm light from the top left.
